title: Build a multi-agent orchestration layer in 2 minutes
description: Spun up a full multi-agent orchestration layer in about 2 minutes. One agent plans, the others build, and they hand work back and forth while I watch. This is the exact setup I teach inside Agent Architects, where nearly 500 of us are building real agent systems. Link in bio, we would love to see you there. skool.com/agent-architects/about
